title: Leaked memo: The Arena Group rebrands to Paradium.AI in pivot to 'publicly traded AI company'
excerpt: Arena Group CEO Paul Edmondson told employees in a memo obtained by Business Insider that it was "more than a name change."
content_html:
Exclusive

By Steven Tweedie

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

and Ben Shimkus

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Goodbye, Arena Group. Hello, Paradium.AI.

The media company that owns publications including TheStreet, Parade, and Men's Journal informed employees in a Monday memo obtained by Business Insider that it was changing its name as part of its evolution into a "publicly traded AI company."

The memo, titled "Today we go 'All In': Introducing Paradium.AI," was sent ahead of a planned announcement during its Q2 earnings after market close on Monday, the CEO wrote.

"This is more than a name change; it is a commitment to our future as a tech-centric leader in media, data, and commerce," CEO Paul Edmondson wrote in the memo, adding that the company was building "a unified, AI-powered ecosystem that empowers us to perform at the speed and scale of artificial intelligence."

The switch comes as many digital publishers confront headwinds to their traditional business models. Referral traffic from search and social platforms has broadly declined.

The Arena Group said Monday that second-quarter revenue fell about 51% from a year earlier, to $22.2 million. Income from continuing operations swung from a $12.4 million profit a year earlier to a $200,000 loss.

The company's shares are down around 48% this year. (The stock popped about 7% following the rebrand news before paring gains toward the 4 p.m. closing bell.)

The new name, which is also a URL, re-routed to The Arena Group's website on Monday afternoon. The company did not immediately provide additional comment when reached by Business Insider.

Other media companies — including BuzzFeed — have turned to AI in search of new growth as their traditional formula of producing or aggregating stories for large audiences has faltered. Other information companies, such as Thomson Reuters and News Corp., have increasingly built AI and data analytics into businesses that extend well beyond publishing.

Read the CEO's full memo to employees

Team,

Today marks a pivotal moment in our company's history. Following the news shared by leaders with their teams this morning and as we prepare for our Q2 earnings call this afternoon, we are incredibly excited to share that The Arena Group is evolving into Paradium.AI.

This is more than a name change; it is a commitment to our future as a tech-centric leader in media, data, and commerce. By integrating the acquisition of Info Sentience and the launch of Cutter Studio, we are building a unified, AI-powered ecosystem that empowers us to perform at the speed and scale of artificial intelligence.

We are entering a rare and exciting moment — the opportunity to be part of a publicly traded AI company during one of the most transformative periods in technology. Together, we have the chance to shape what comes next and help build the future of AI-powered innovation.

The public announcement will be distributed shortly. Please remember that this information remains confidential until 4:05 PM ET today when we release our Q2 results.

Best,

Paul Edmondson
CEO

作者：Steven Tweedie 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。 和 Ben Shimkus 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

再见，竞技场集团。 你好，Paradium.AI。

这家拥有《TheStreet》、《Parade》和《Men's Journal》等刊物的媒体公司在《商业内幕》周一获得的一份备忘录中告知员工，该公司正在更名，作为其向“上市人工智能公司”发展的一部分。

这位首席执行官写道，这份题为“今天我们‘全力以赴’：介绍 Paradium.AI”的备忘录是在周一收盘后在第二季度财报期间发布的计划之前发送的。

首席执行官保罗·埃德蒙森（Paul Edmondson）在备忘录中写道：“这不仅仅是更名；这是对我们作为媒体、数据和商业领域以技术为中心的领导者的未来的承诺。”他补充说，该公司正在构建“一个统一的、由人工智能驱动的生态系统，使我们能够以人工智能的速度和规模执行任务。”

这一转变发生之际，许多数字出版商正面临传统商业模式的阻力。 来自搜索和社交平台的推荐流量普遍下降。

Arena Group 周一表示，第二季度收入较上年同期下降约 51%，至 2220 万美元。 持续经营业务的收入从一年前的 1,240 万美元利润变为亏损 20 万美元。

今年该公司股价下跌约48%。 （品牌重塑消息传出后，该股上涨约 7%，但在下午 4 点之前涨幅回落。 结束钟声。）

新名称也是一个 URL，于周一下午重新路由至 The Arena Group 的网站。 当《商业内幕》联系到该公司时，该公司没有立即发表更多评论。

其他媒体公司——包括 BuzzFeed——已经转向人工智能来寻求新的增长，因为它们为大量受众制作或聚合故事的传统模式已经动摇。 汤森路透和新闻集团等其他信息公司越来越多地将人工智能和数据分析融入到出版以外的业务中。

阅读首席执行官给员工的完整备忘录

Team,

今天是我们公司历史上的关键时刻。 继今天早上领导人及其团队分享的消息以及今天下午我们为第二季度财报电话会议做准备时，我们非常高兴地宣布 The Arena Group 正在演变为 Paradium.AI。

这不仅仅是更名；这是对我们作为媒体、数据和商业领域以技术为中心的领导者的未来的承诺。 通过整合对 Info Sentience 的收购和 Cutter Studio 的推出，我们正在构建一个统一的、人工智能驱动的生态系统，使我们能够以人工智能的速度和规模执行任务。

我们正在进入一个罕见且令人兴奋的时刻——在技术最具变革性的时期之一，有机会成为一家上市人工智能公司的一部分。 我们有机会共同塑造未来并帮助构建人工智能驱动的创新的未来。

该公告将于近期发布。 请记住，在今天下午 4:05（美国东部时间）我们发布第二季度业绩之前，此信息将一直保密。

Best,

Paul Edmondson首席执行官
